experiments.study_type: prostate cancer initiation and metastasis model
experiments.procedure_text: Surgical delivery of Cre/Luciferase lentivirus (LV-Cre/ Luci) into the right anterior prostate in triple-knockin Pten loxP/loxP -Trp53 loxP/loxP -Ai9(RCL-tdT) mice.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Surgical delivery of Cre/Luciferase lentivirus (LV-Cre/ Luci) into the right anterior prostate in triple-knockin Pten loxP/loxP -Trp53 loxP/loxP -Ai9(RCL-tdT) mice.
experiments.species_evidence: Pten loxP/loxP , Trp53 loxP/loxP , and wild-type C57BL/6J mice
experiments.test_system_evidence: In vivo and ex-vivo, bioluminescence imaging was performed

endpoints.label: bioluminescence imaging
endpoints.evidence: Bioluminescence signal reveals metastatic disease spread across the body at 15 months post-injection.

endpoints.label: 3D reconstruction of tissue
endpoints.evidence: 3D reconstruction of the imaged prostate (4 mm × 1.6 mm × 7 mm) from a RapidCaP mouse

endpoints.label: volume quantification of foci
endpoints.evidence: Quantification of the complete volume of the tdT + focal regions (mm 3 ) in prostate

endpoints.label: nuclear size quantification
endpoints.evidence: Quantification of the increase in nuclear size of tdT + compared to nearby tdT -epithelial cells

endpoints.label: metastatic cell count and distribution
endpoints.evidence: The density of total tdTomato + /-cells in the brain areas was obtained

substances.name: luciferin
substances.evidence: animals received intraperitoneal injections of 200 mg/kg luciferin

experiments.exposure_evidence: 20 μL of the concentrated virus was injected into the right anterior prostate.
experiments.regulatory_evidence: All protocols for mouse experiments were performed following the institutional guidelines protocols and were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
experiments.notes: Experimental animals were male mice between 2 to 6 months old, with an additional cohort for metastasis analysis at 15 months.
